Title: Dependency Development Lineage & Context Resolver
Summary: READ/ANALYZE/CONTEXT-only dependency resolver (Lane B). Reads what each governed dependency ACTUALLY delivered (verified development lineage) and reconciles that history against the CURRENT repository, so M05/M07/M09 handoffs and later automatic AI execution receive compact, verified, fresh dependency context instead of a flat "C depends on A and B". Deterministic: zero AI calls, zero paid API calls, zero network calls. No provider names and no model selection anywhere (ADR-005). Dependency relationships are READ, never redesigned; roadmap/phase/milestone/sequence/architecture/dependency structure is never autonomously modified. All 15 required capabilities implemented and tested; orchestrator Get-DbM181TaskDependencyContext provides a one-shot bundle (graph+lineage+reconciliation+index+freshness+relevance+context) for the three additive command integrations (M05/M07/M09), each Test-Path guarded so absence or soft failure never alters existing stdout markers, exit codes, or the mandatory zero-context sections. Repository-unavailable fallback is UNVERIFIED (never falsely STALE), so an unavailable repository can never block a governed handoff.
